title: Verify mastery: Neural Self-Repair & Hot-Reload
goal: VC-200-002 (P1) claims mastery of: Autonomous Trait Patching. Its own narrative does not claim delivery: PARTIAL, reinterpreted: literal runtime Rust trait patching isn't achievable in safe Rust. Delivered the mechanism, not yet the capability — `resolve_capability_gap` now falls back to `ReflexSynthesizer::synthesize_wasm_reflex`, which generates and compiles an input-dependent WASI reflex and hot-loads it via the existing `reflex_<name>` convention with **no daemon restart** (`src/gawd/reflex_synth. Prove or refute it: add a nonzero test named vc_200_002_mastery_* that exercises the capability on its production path, and record exactly which part is missing when it cannot be proven. Coverage is not mastery: this closes only when the capability is verified, and a linked closed task is not evidence.
